acquisition method: Data was acquired in data dependent acquisition (DDA) mode, using a Top20 method.
alkylation reagent: alkylated with 10 mM iodoacetamide (Sigma) in the dark for 45 min at room temperature.
alkylation concentration: alkylated with 10 mM iodoacetamide (Sigma) in the dark for 45 min at room temperature.
cleavage agent: Proteins were then subjected to digestion with trypsin (Promega; Madison, WI, USA) overnight at 37°C at 50:1 protein:trypsin ratio, followed by a second trypsin digestion for 4 h.
instrument: coupled online through a nanoESI emitter (10 μm tip; New Objective; Woburn, MA, USA) to a quadrupole orbitrap mass spectrometer (Q Exactive Plus, Thermo Scientific)
ionization type: coupled online through a nanoESI emitter (10 μm tip; New Objective; Woburn, MA, USA)
labeling: Sample of non-radioactive methylation assay containing 2 μg His-TWIST1 and 4μg GST SETD6 were incubated with 3.2 mM SAM overnight at 30°C. An additional sample without SAM served as reference.
mass analyzer: coupled online through a nanoESI emitter (10 μm tip; New Objective; Woburn, MA, USA) to a quadrupole orbitrap mass spectrometer (Q Exactive Plus, Thermo Scientific)
ptm: fixed carbamidomethylation on C; variable protein N-terminal acetylation; oxidation on M; deamidation on NQ; methylation on K; dimethylation on K; trimethylation on K

Data was analysed using Byonic search engine (Protein Metrics) against the Human protein database (SwissProt Dec20) allowing for the following modifications: fixed carbamidomethylation on C, variable protein N-terminal acetylation, oxidation on M, deamidation on NQ, methylation on K, dimethylation on K and trimethylation on K.
reduction reagent: proteins were reduced with 5 mM dithiothreitol (Sigma) for 1 h at room temperature
reduction concentration: proteins were reduced with 5 mM dithiothreitol (Sigma) for 1 h at room temperature
